question: Show all artists
reference_sql: SELECT ArtistId, Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name
notes: Basic single-table scan

question: How many albums are there in total?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_albums FROM Album
notes: Scalar aggregation

question: List all tracks by AC/DC
reference_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'
notes: 3-table join, string filter

question: What are the available music genres?
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name
notes: DISTINCT on single table

question: List all customers from Brazil
reference_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY LastName
notes: Simple filter

question: How many tracks are there in the Jazz genre?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(t.TrackId) AS jazz_tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'
notes: COUNT with JOIN and filter

question: List all media types available
reference_sql: SELECT MediaTypeId, Name FROM MediaType ORDER BY Name
notes: Single table scan on MediaType

question: Show the top 5 artists by number of tracks
reference_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 5
notes: Multi-table join with aggregation, ORDER BY, LIMIT

question: Which customers have spent the most? Show top 10
reference_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Country ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10
notes: Customer-Invoice join with GROUP BY SUM

question: List all albums with their artist names
reference_sql: SELECT al.Title AS album_title, ar.Name AS artist_name FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId ORDER BY ar.Name, al.Title
notes: 2-table join

question: Show each employee and the number of customers they support
reference_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY customer_count DESC
notes: Employee-Customer LEFT JOIN

question: List invoice line items with track name and invoice total
reference_sql: SELECT il.InvoiceLineId, t.Name AS track_name, il.UnitPrice, il.Quantity, i.Total AS invoice_total FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId LIMIT 50
notes: 3-table join InvoiceLine→Track→Invoice

question: Which playlists contain tracks from the Rock genre?
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Name AS playlist FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' ORDER BY p.Name
notes: 4-table join with DISTINCT, tests playlist_track junction

question: What is the average invoice total by country?
reference_sql: SELECT c.Country, AVG(i.Total) AS avg_invoice_total FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY avg_invoice_total DESC
notes: AVG with GROUP BY

question: Which genres have more than 100 tracks?
reference_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 100 ORDER BY track_count DESC
notes: GROUP BY with HAVING

question: What is the total revenue per year?
reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS annual_revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
notes: Date extraction with GROUP BY

question: Find artists with more than 10 albums
reference_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10 ORDER BY album_count DESC
notes: HAVING filter on aggregated join

question: What is the total revenue by country, sorted from highest to lowest?
reference_sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS total_revenue FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
notes: GROUP BY country with SUM and ORDER

question: Show all invoices from 2009
reference_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, CustomerId, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) = 2009 ORDER BY InvoiceDate
notes: Date range filter with EXTRACT

question: What is the total revenue in the first half of 2010?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2010-07-01'
notes: Date range with SUM

question: Which month of 2011 had the highest sales?
reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS monthly_sales FROM Invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) = 2011 GROUP BY month ORDER BY monthly_sales DESC LIMIT 1
notes: Month extraction, GROUP BY, ORDER BY aggregation

question: Show me the top 5 artists by revenue
reference_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
notes: First turn: sets up context

question: Now show me their album counts as well
reference_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
notes: Second turn: 'their' must resolve to top 5 artists from prior turn

question: List all Rock tracks
reference_sql: SELECT t.Name, al.Title AS album, ar.Name AS artist FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' ORDER BY t.Name
notes: First turn: Rock tracks

question: Filter those to only show tracks longer than 5 minutes
reference_sql: SELECT t.Name, al.Title AS album, ar.Name AS artist, t.Milliseconds FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' AND t.Milliseconds > 300000 ORDER BY t.Milliseconds DESC
notes: Second turn: 'those' = Rock tracks, adds duration filter

question: How many customers are there per country?
reference_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY customer_count DESC
notes: First turn: customer counts

question: Which of those countries also have the highest average invoice total?
reference_sql: SELECT c.Country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS customer_count, AVG(i.Total) AS avg_invoice FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY avg_invoice DESC
notes: Second turn: 'those countries' links to prior result

question: For each artist, what is their best-selling track (by total units sold)?
reference_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, t.Name AS top_track, SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_sold FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, t.TrackId, t.Name ORDER BY ar.Name, units_sold DESC
notes: Complex multi-join with per-artist top-track aggregation

question: Which tracks appear in the most playlists?
reference_sql: SELECT t.Name AS track, ar.Name AS artist, COUNT(pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count FROM Track t JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY t.TrackId, t.Name, ar.Name ORDER BY playlist_count DESC LIMIT 10
notes: Junction table + multi-join aggregation

question: Find customers who have never purchased any track from the Rock genre
reference_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Country FROM Customer c WHERE c.CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock') ORDER BY c.LastName
notes: Anti-join using NOT IN subquery across 5 tables
